page: Amazon Web Services i4i.32xlarge is a storage-optimized instance powered by the AWS Nitro System and 3rd Generation Intel Xeon Scalable processors (Ice Lake 8375C). Operating on the x86_64 architecture with an all-core turbo frequency of up to 3.5 GHz, the instance supplies 128 vCPUs across 64 dedicated physical cores with multithreading enabled. The CPU configuration provides 54 MB of shared L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 with VNNI, VAES, and SHA-NI cryptographic hardware extensions.

System memory consists of 1,024 GB of DDR4 RAM clocked at 3 GHz, allocating 8 GB of memory per physical core. The hardware architecture features 30,000 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage alongside 75 Gbps of baseline networking bandwidth. There are no discrete GPU accelerators included in this configuration.

Benchmark evaluation highlights massive parallel compute and memory throughput. The server achieved top-tier performance in PassMark CPU tests (86,632.57) and multi-core stress testing, as well as high-throughput vector processing via AVX-512 extensions. In-memory data store performance is corroborated by 104.77 million operations per second in Redis SET evaluations and strong database operations scaling. While single-thread benchmarks reflect standard Xeon frequencies, multi-threaded Clang compilation and web serving throughput of 70.79 GB/sec demonstrate high scalability. Large-model LLM generation performance is limited due to the absence of dedicated GPU hardware.

The dense integration of high-speed local NVMe capacity, 1 TB of system memory, and 75 Gbps interconnect yields strong qualitative resource efficiency for I/O-intensive workloads. The instance is suited for distributed NoSQL databases, transactional relational database clusters, real-time analytics engines, and high-throughput data processing pipelines requiring direct local storage.
description: Amazon Web Services i4i.32xlarge is a storage-optimized server engineered for data-intensive and high-transaction applications. Driven by dual-socket 3rd Generation Intel Xeon Scalable 8375C processors running on the x86_64 Nitro platform, it provides 128 vCPUs (64 physical cores) at 3.5 GHz and 1,024 GB of DDR4 system memory. Storage is anchored by 30,000 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD capacity, supported by 75 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth without discrete GPUs. Benchmark results confirm superior parallel throughput, with top-tier ratings in PassMark CPU compute and AVX-512 vector execution, alongside strong performance in multi-threaded database tasks and Redis in-memory key-value operations reaching 104.77 million ops/sec. While single-threaded processing reflects typical enterprise CPU baselines, the server offers dense throughput and low I/O latency for large-scale distributed databases, transactional storage systems, and real-time big data analytics pipelines.
